dateAssessment: Relative days follow the transcript: two completed overnight transitions separate the reunion, sailing day, and rescue dawn. November is spoken; year and exact days come only from YAML. The recorded November 8–9 span conflicts with the narrated transitions, as does the episode timeline’s same-day reunion and sailing. Conditional on a November 8 reunion, sailing is November 9 and the rescue dawn is November 10. The final return to Hamri has no stated duration or clock.

watches.summary: The reunion is explicitly late morning, approximately the midday watch.
After preparations and town errands, departure is early the next morning.
Five–six hours sailing after early departure places the marsh approach around midday.
About three hours since Blu left near Eskorola’s approach; the brief wait for Itzal is included.
Blu returns as the sun sinks; a subsequent time check confirms sunset.
Overnight lodging ends with waking at break of dawn before departure.
Dawn departure plus about two hours paddling and one spell-hour; the final approach is nested.
